pr_title: Restore gltf embedded scenes due to problems with textures.
pr_body:
gltf: Avoid using base64 hash as an image filename

Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/72197

How does this fix?

It ignores the base 64 string or the buffer. Consistently use the images.name property with deduplication, or else the image index. Does not use the material name because we don't know yet.

we should try and use the d["name"] if it exists. otherwise, fallback to textures or material names
NOTE: we should check some files from a few different DCC to see how they handle this.

And then fallback to index only if no name

images->name exists in blender embedded exports.
Updated. For now I'm only using image["name"]. using material name is rather tricky, especially if they use multiple texture maps which all need unique names assigned.
